value.answer: Reaching out for a therapist is a good step, and I'm glad you did. If things get urgent where you are, ConnexOntario is open 24 hours at 1-866-531-2600. For finding someone in Toronto, Psychotherapy Referral Service has been connecting people with registered psychotherapists since 1995, and you can contact therapists from their profiles directly. If cost is the worry, Family Service Toronto has sliding-scale fees based on income. Also check your work benefits: extended health plans often cover private therapy, and an Employee Assistance Program may include a few free sessions a year. If it's depression or anxiety, the Ontario Structured Psychotherapy program is free and short-term.
